intent.description: 将已批准的人物角色图拆成综合色块图、结构线稿图和3D白膜图三路并行生成，再以原图为身份与构图权威进行最终合成，得到更干净、稳定的真人角色资产。用于用户提到“洗图”“人物图去脏”“角色资产清洗”“色块加线稿加白膜”“三图并行后合图”时。不要用于普通抠图、单步修图、单纯换背景、剧情关键帧或视频生成。
intent.job_to_be_done: Clean an approved character asset through separated color-value, contour and volume guides without changing the character.
target_users: AI video creators using local agent skills

should_trigger: 请使用 character-asset-cleanup，以这张已确认人物图为原图，并行制作色块、线稿、白膜三路，全部验收后再合图，保留身份和构图。
人物洗图：三图并行，色块线稿白膜

trust.source_asset_policy: only use an explicitly approved character asset

permissions.network: only through the active image-generation provider when requested
permissions.file_read: approved source image and scoped asset records
permissions.file_write: new non-overwriting cleanup experiment directory only

degradation.openai: use available image generation with explicit reference roles; do not claim unsupported ControlNet weights
degradation.claude: requires an available image-generation tool or produces prompts and gates only
degradation.generic: requires concurrent image-generation capability; otherwise report serial limitation before execution
degradation.agent-skills-compatible: canonical workflow with provider-specific image adapter

scaffold: three guide images started concurrently when the tool supports it
all three guide gates pass before final composition
final output remains a non-overwriting candidate until user approval

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
